answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each new agent to lock a small refundable stake in a shared vault before it may trade, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive rather than free. Reputation then accrues slowly, like an ember building heat over many verified transactions, instead of being granted at birth. A nebula of independent attestors, diverse peers who have themselves staked, must vouch for a newcomer before its stake unlocks full trading rights, so one operator cannot cheaply vouch for its own sock puppets.
